retainedFailuresAndLimits.attributionBuildFailure: Initial json! macro rejected an unparenthesized array-index expression. Parenthesized it before any diagnostic browser run; failed build log retained.
retainedFailuresAndLimits.auditLimits: One perpetual-motion enabled control exceeded256 buffered events; full timeout/no-input/concurrency/close outcomes pass, but log does not observe the post32 fallback. Source retains the fallback; no native race or exact cadence claim.
retainedFailuresAndLimits.decision: Reject standalone bounded unstable retry screen; no unchanged repeat or adoption. Do not claim any500ms pause caused previous SVGOMG variance. Native coarse action path also has two retained negative screens and should not be repeated unchanged.

limitations: No observed500ms retry pause in these four audited application captures. The prior half-second duration difference remains causally unproven.
The two four-worker Reset all actions spent225.71/224.35ms in0/20/100/100ms retry pauses. This supports targeted investigation, not a removable-time bound. One single-worker action needed no retry.
No new timing policy bypasses readiness, targeting, original ownership or input acknowledgement. Per-attempt delivery state was not logged; source restricts the cap to aggregate NotDispatched.

One enabled perpetual-motion control truncated its256-event diagnostic buffer. Timeout/no-input outcome passes, but the log does not observe the post32 fallback; that bound is established by source inspection only.

Two reversed blocks do not establish confidence or final majority performance. Four-worker SVGOMG improves2.88/22.02%, failing the both-block10% criterion; one single-worker SVGOMG comparison increases owner-intervalCPU8.76%.
No adoption or unchanged larger screen follows. Original source/module state and exact baseline driver are restored; native browser remains unchanged.
Full native race/mutation/callback custody, full-current-core refresh, broader runtime/platform and release gates remain open.
